name: Broken Arrow — Usage & Diagnostics
description: Consent-based desktop telemetry. Online means presence in the last five minutes. Validation events are excluded. Installations count first execution.

insights.name: Installations: first runs by day
insights.description: New local profiles first executed; excludes integration validation. Installer completions without a launch are not observable.
insights.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, count(DISTINCT properties.installation_id) AS installations FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'app_installed' AND properties.kind = 'first_run' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

insights.name: Online users: last 5 minutes
insights.description: Latest presence identity per installation, then distinct users. Includes app background presence; expires after five minutes.
insights.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS online_users FROM (SELECT argMax(distinct_id, timestamp) AS user_id FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event IN ('app_started', 'app_heartbeat', 'user_identified') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY properties.installation_id)

insights.name: User versions: latest recognized account version
insights.description: Most recent version for each recognized game account active in the last seven days. Only accounts confirmed by this launch's game logs enter account-version statistics; see installation version share and identity coverage for cached/unidentified clients.
insights.sql: SELECT version, count() AS users FROM (SELECT argMax(properties.version, timestamp) AS version FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND properties.identity_source = 'game_account' AND properties.identity_confidence = 'confirmed' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY distinct_id) GROUP BY version ORDER BY users DESC

insights.name: Updates: new versions actually run
insights.description: Version transitions observed on a later launch, including manual replacements and downgrades. Does not treat an install click as update success.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.previous_version AS from_version, properties.version AS to_version, count(DISTINCT properties.installation_id) AS installations FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'app_updated' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY from_version, to_version ORDER BY installations DESC

insights.name: Feature usage, success, and latency
insights.description: Selected user actions; timings in milliseconds. Background polling is excluded.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.operation AS operation, count() AS uses, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS users, round(100.0 * countIf(properties.result = 'success') / count(), 1) AS success_percent, round(quantile(0.5)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)), 1) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)), 1) AS p95_ms FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'operation_completed' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY operation ORDER BY uses DESC

insights.name: Errors: classified samples and affected users
insights.description: Classified exceptions and repeated-occurrence summaries, with app code positions and no raw messages. Occurrence totals include aggregated duplicates.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.source AS source, properties.operation AS operation, properties.error_type AS error_type, properties.error_code AS error_code, sum(toInt(coalesce(properties.occurrences, 1))) AS occurrences, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS affected_users FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event IN ('$exception', 'exception_summary') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY source, operation, error_type, error_code ORDER BY occurrences DESC

insights.name: Performance: startup and renderer long tasks
insights.description: UI-ready startup duration percentiles. Renderer long-task values are per-window maxima; counts and blocking totals are available in the separate long-task aggregate view.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.metric AS metric, properties.version AS version, count() AS samples, round(quantile(0.5)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)), 1) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)), 1) AS p95_ms FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'performance_sample' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY metric, version ORDER BY metric, version

insights.name: Performance: main-process CPU and memory
insights.description: Minute heartbeat samples from Electron main process. This does not include total renderer or system resource usage.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.version AS version, round(avg(toFloat(properties.cpu_percent)), 1) AS average_cpu_percent, round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.rss_mb)), 1) AS p95_rss_mb, round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.heap_used_mb)), 1) AS p95_heap_mb FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'app_heartbeat' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY version ORDER BY version

insights.name: Update delivery states
insights.description: Unique installations reaching updater states; progress-only changes are suppressed.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.target_version AS target_version, properties.status AS status, count(DISTINCT properties.installation_id) AS installations FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'update_state_changed' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY target_version, status ORDER BY target_version, status

insights.name: Feature views and recording sessions
insights.description: Explicit navigation and APM/recording start/stop events. Passive list polling is excluded.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.feature AS feature, properties.action AS action, count() AS uses, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS users FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'feature_used' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY feature, action ORDER BY uses DESC

insights.name: Version share: latest active account version
insights.description: Latest confirmed version per game account active in the last seven days; each account counts once. Percentages exclude validation, cached, and unidentified clients. See installation-version share and identity coverage for those clients.
insights.sql: SELECT version, users, round(100.0 * users / nullIf(sum(users) OVER (), 0), 2) AS share_percent FROM (SELECT version, count() AS users FROM (SELECT argMax(properties.version, timestamp) AS version FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND properties.identity_source = 'game_account' AND properties.identity_confidence = 'confirmed' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY distinct_id) GROUP BY version) ORDER BY users DESC, version DESC

insights.name: Foreground and active users: last 5 minutes
insights.description: Latest state per installation, then unique identities. App presence, foreground, and active use are counted separately.
insights.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS online_users, count(DISTINCT if(foreground IN ('true', '1'), user_id, NULL)) AS foreground_users, count(DISTINCT if(active IN ('true', '1'), user_id, NULL)) AS active_users FROM (SELECT argMax(distinct_id, timestamp) AS user_id, argMax(properties.foreground, timestamp) AS foreground, argMax(properties.active, timestamp) AS active FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'app_heartbeat' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY properties.installation_id)

insights.name: Identity coverage: latest account confidence
insights.description: Latest account identification state per recently active installation. Cached identities are distinguished from accounts confirmed by this launch's logs.
insights.sql: SELECT identity_confidence, count() AS installations, round(100.0 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 1) AS share_percent FROM (SELECT argMax(properties.identity_confidence, timestamp) AS identity_confidence FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY properties.installation_id) GROUP BY identity_confidence ORDER BY installations DESC

insights.name: Installation version share: all active installations
insights.description: Latest version per installation, including installations without a recognized game account.
insights.sql: SELECT version, count() AS installations, round(100.0 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS share_percent FROM (SELECT argMax(properties.version, timestamp) AS version FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY properties.installation_id) GROUP BY version ORDER BY installations DESC

insights.name: Update attempts: confirmed outcomes
insights.description: One outcome per update_attempt_id. Install application failures are distinct from interrupted downloads.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.target_version AS target_version, properties.outcome AS outcome, properties.last_stage AS last_stage, count(DISTINCT properties.update_attempt_id) AS attempts FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'update_attempt_result' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY target_version, outcome, last_stage ORDER BY target_version, outcome

insights.name: Process exits: exception and unclean recovery
insights.description: An unclean exit may reflect a kill, power loss, or crash; only exception-marked exits are labeled as exceptions.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.previous_version AS version, properties.reason AS reason, count(DISTINCT properties.previous_run_id) AS exits FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'previous_run_exit' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY version, reason ORDER BY exits DESC

insights.name: Renderer long tasks: counts and blocking time
insights.description: Minute aggregates include all observed tasks, not one selected task. Duration columns are totals or per-window maxima.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.version AS version, sum(toFloat(properties.task_count)) AS long_tasks, round(sum(toFloat(properties.blocking_duration_ms)), 1) AS total_blocking_ms, round(max(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)), 1) AS longest_task_ms FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'performance_sample' AND properties.metric = 'renderer_long_tasks' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY version ORDER BY long_tasks DESC

insights.name: Delivery health: dropped events and retries
insights.description: Cumulative counters are reduced to maxima per app run before summing. Shutdown summaries include unsent noncritical events; counters measure retry requests, not queued retries.
insights.sql: SELECT version, sum(dropped) AS dropped_events, sum(retried) AS retries, sum(persistence_failures) AS storage_failures FROM (SELECT argMax(properties.version, timestamp) AS version, max(toFloat(properties.delivery_dropped_total)) AS dropped, max(toFloat(properties.delivery_retried_total)) AS retried, max(toFloat(properties.persistence_failures_total)) AS persistence_failures FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event IN ('app_heartbeat', 'delivery_summary') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY properties.app_session_id) GROUP BY version ORDER BY dropped_events DESC

insights.name: Daily active accounts
insights.description: Accounts performing an explicit feature view or user action, excluding background presence and unrecognized installations.
insights.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS daily_active_accounts FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND properties.identity_source = 'game_account' AND properties.identity_confidence = 'confirmed' AND event IN ('feature_used','operation_completed') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

insights.name: Weekly active accounts
insights.description: Unique recognized accounts using a feature during each calendar week.
insights.sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp) AS week, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS weekly_active_accounts FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND properties.identity_source = 'game_account' AND properties.identity_confidence = 'confirmed' AND event IN ('feature_used','operation_completed') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: Return usage: day 1 and day 7
insights.description: Return rates for accounts first observed during the last 30 days. Each interval includes only cohorts old enough to have returned.
insights.sql: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT distinct_id AS user_id, min(toDate(timestamp)) AS first_day FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND properties.identity_source = 'game_account' AND properties.identity_confidence = 'confirmed' AND event IN ('feature_used','operation_completed') GROUP BY distinct_id), activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id AS user_id, toDate(timestamp) AS day FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND properties.identity_source = 'game_account' AND properties.identity_confidence = 'confirmed' AND event IN ('feature_used','operation_completed')) SELECT count(DISTINCT first_seen.user_id) AS accounts, count(DISTINCT if(first_day <= today() - INTERVAL 1 DAY, first_seen.user_id, NULL)) AS day_1_eligible, count(DISTINCT if(day = first_day + INTERVAL 1 DAY, first_seen.user_id, NULL)) AS day_1_returned, count(DISTINCT if(first_day <= today() - INTERVAL 7 DAY, first_seen.user_id, NULL)) AS day_7_eligible, count(DISTINCT if(day = first_day + INTERVAL 7 DAY, first_seen.user_id, NULL)) AS day_7_returned FROM first_seen LEFT JOIN activity ON first_seen.user_id = activity.user_id WHERE first_day > today() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

insights.name: Release health: error-rate alert
insights.description: Flags versions with at least 20 operations and failure rate above 5%. Treat as an operational threshold, not a statistical significance test.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.version AS version, count() AS operations, countIf(properties.result = 'failure') AS failures, round(100.0 * failures / count(), 1) AS failure_percent, if(count() >= 20, failure_percent, 0) AS alert_value, if(count() >= 20 AND 100.0 * failures / count() > 5, 'ALERT', 'OK') AS status FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'operation_completed' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY version ORDER BY failure_percent DESC

insights.name: Renderer CPU and memory
insights.description: Aggregate resources of all Electron renderer processes, sampled with presence. CPU is percent of one logical core and can exceed 100%.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.version AS version, round(avg(toFloat(properties.renderer_cpu_percent)), 1) AS average_renderer_cpu_percent, round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.renderer_rss_mb)), 1) AS p95_renderer_rss_mb, round(max(toFloat(properties.renderer_processes)), 0) AS renderer_processes FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND event = 'app_heartbeat' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY version ORDER BY version

insights.name: Native sessions: active usage
insights.description: Distinct UUIDv7 PostHog session IDs associated with explicit feature usage or user actions. Sessions rotate after inactivity, user changes, or 24 hours.
insights.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, count(DISTINCT properties.$session_id) AS sessions FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'brokenarrow.desktop' AND coalesce(toString(properties.validation), 'false') NOT IN ('true', '1') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL AND event IN ('feature_used','operation_completed') AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
